rows.abstract: The bill establishes a tax-exempt Workers' Compensation Program that will promote a culture of safe and healthy work environment in order to minimize the incidence of work contingencies, ensure prompt and adequate compensation in the event of work contingencies  and provide occupationally-disabled workers with rehabilitation services.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2007-11-12
